role: search-opponent and rail plates for the measured flex boxes
not: a slice or stretch of button-steel-rest, and not a shrink of the boxes
covers: each drawing is opaque to all four edges, so contain fills its box and no background shows at the edges or corners
fit: one new drawing, uniform scale to width 1538, vertical centre crop to height 294, then the centre length removed to the measured box aspect; uniform resample only, no 100% 100%
pressed: same pixels as each rest, lighting only
webp: libwebp quality 82; opaque lossy VP8, no alpha channel
tool: cx built-in image_gen, account2, no PixelLab
